home.headline: Custom websites designed for you.
home.microCta: If you'd like to work with me or request my CV, feel free to reach out anytime.

about.block1Text: I’m Manuel Alejandro Pérez, a Frontend Developer specialized in Angular with over 3 years of professional experience building modern, scalable and maintainable web applications. I’m known for being autonomous, organized and focused on code quality and user experience. Beyond development, I enjoy learning new tools, optimizing workflows, and offering both technical and creative solutions.
about.block2Text: I’ve worked with Angular and TypeScript in real production environments for companies such as Técnicas Competitivas and Ultebra Solutions, contributing to full features, ongoing maintenance, interface design, backend work with .NET Core and Node.js, SQL query optimization and agile teamwork. I also have graphic design training, which enhances my projects visually through custom icons, vectors, layouts and infographics. My goal is to deliver clean, functional and visually refined solutions, either as part of a team or as a freelancer.

frontend.title: Frontend Development with Angular
frontend.desc: Building modern, fast and scalable web applications using Angular and TypeScript. Clean architecture, reusable components, Material Design and best practices.

fullstack.title: Full Stack Development
fullstack.desc: API and backend system development with .NET Core or Node.js. REST controllers, data validation and service integration.

webDesign.title: Web Design & Layout
webDesign.desc: Clear, accessible and responsive user interfaces using HTML and SCSS. Pixel-perfect layout and seamless integration into Angular.

performance.title: Performance Optimization
performance.desc: Improving loading performance, resource usage, SQL queries and DOM structure to maximize real-world efficiency.

graphicDesign.title: Graphic Design for Web
graphicDesign.desc: Creation of icons, vectors, illustrations and custom infographics — perfect for landings, portfolios or corporate websites.

testing.title: Automated Testing (Cypress)
testing.desc: End-to-end testing with Cypress, selecting critical flows and building stable automated suites.

ux.title: UX Consulting
ux.desc: Interface analysis, usability improvement, flow design, information architecture and micro-interactions.

firebase.title: Firebase Integration
firebase.desc: Authentication, database, file storage and hosting with Firebase — ideal for small and medium-sized projects.

agile.title: Agile Work Methodologies
agile.desc: Task management, technical documentation, GitFlow and efficient collaboration in Scrum or Kanban teams.
